prompts.prompt: Never have I ever waved back at someone who was greeting a different person.
Never have I ever packed for a trip and forgotten the one item I needed most.
Never have I ever tried to recreate a restaurant dish at home.
Never have I ever fallen asleep before the end of a movie I chose.
Never have I ever sent a message to the wrong chat.
Never have I ever danced in a kitchen while waiting for food.
Never have I ever taken a photo of a meal before eating it.
Never have I ever pretended to understand directions and then got lost.
Never have I ever bought a plant and forgotten its name.
Never have I ever laughed so hard that I could not finish a sentence.
Never have I ever worn mismatched socks outside the house.
Never have I ever planned a surprise that was discovered early.
Never have I ever ordered the same favorite meal three times in one week.
Never have I ever started a book and skipped to the ending.
Never have I ever sung a lyric incorrectly for years.
Never have I ever kept a ticket or receipt as a memory.
Never have I ever built a blanket fort as an adult.
Never have I ever taken the scenic route by accident.
Never have I ever tried a hobby because someone I cared about loved it.
Never have I ever laughed during a moment when I was supposed to be serious.
Never have I ever stayed up later than planned because the conversation was good.
Never have I ever named an object such as a car, plant, or appliance.
Never have I ever eaten breakfast food for dinner.
Never have I ever made a playlist for a particular person or memory.
